decisions.reason: Because the accelerator remained on the home page in both 2023 and 2024, management has made a visible public commitment to it and, in a growing firm, is likely to continue it despite its more peripheral fit to the machinery core.

The binder still had its own page in 2024, showing continued commitment, but as a less prominently presented and somewhat less core offering it is the easiest of the remaining products to drop if justification weakens.

The decontamination plant is close to the established offer and was prominently featured on the home page with repeated launch claims, so sunk effort, strategic fit, and public commitment make management very likely to persist with it.
